product_metadata.title: Tribesigns White Shoe Rack, Shoe Shelf, Shoe Storage Organizer for Door, Entryway, Large Shoe Rack for Men,8 Tiers Shoe Organizer
features: White Metal Shoe Rack: It is made of metal tubes and sturdy joints, strong load ability, great for long time use. Item itself is lightweight, convenient to move it anywhere.

Large Capacity for Men’s Shoes and Boots: It can store up to 26pairs shoes, with different height design, it can fit boots, high heels and men’s large shoes. With side hooks(ONLY ONE), you can hang a lot of things on it. Very innovative design. The PP plastic sheet of its top is dust-proof and easy to clean. Dimensions: 33.46"W*12"D*48.81"H.
Top PP Cover-Dust-proof: Top shelf adopted two PP cover, it's easy to clean, just wipe it by wet cloth. You can place your handbags on the top shelf.
Easy to Assemble: It is easy to assemble. Setup takes only a few simple steps. Comes with user manual to help you assemble it quickly and easily.
